source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hello [FREELANCER_NAME_001]!

At the moment, I’m using my LinkedIn to run an urgent MeetAlfred campaign. Could we begin with only Apollo and HubSpot?

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: For the moment, please connect the email to MeetAlfred and Hubspot. Also ensure that lists can be pushed from Hubspot to MeetAlfred.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: For the moment, please connect the email to MeetAlfred and Hubspot. Also ensure that lists can be pushed from Hubspot to MeetAlfred.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I added many additional leads to that test campaign in Hubspot, but there are still 23 in Meet Alfred.

execution.observed_behavior: After additional leads were added in HubSpot, the corresponding MeetAlfred campaign remained at 23 leads.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I did not manually add any contacts to MeetAlfred. It is supposed to import lists from Hubspot.

execution.observed_behavior: A newly configured and published Zap connected to a new MeetAlfred campaign produced a campaign showing zero leads.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: When a new lead is added to the Hubspot list, it gets sent to Alfred. Leads that were already there before the Zapp was created are not being pushed.

execution.observed_behavior: The Zap sends newly added HubSpot-list leads to MeetAlfred but does not push leads that were already in the list before the Zap was created.

routing_warnings.description: The message explains how to create a new MeetAlfred campaign and duplicate and rename its Zap, which is campaign provisioning rather than evidence that leads synchronized.
The message reports completion of the new campaign-and-Zap setup but does not claim or verify successful lead synchronization.
Pausing the old list to prevent obsolete messages is a production campaign safety action.
The client confirms that the campaign was launched, but does not explicitly confirm that HubSpot leads synchronized into MeetAlfred.
